evidence_gaps.what: Complete petrol and diesel engine-to-trim combinations, and the current status of S(O) Knight automatic features
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The registry gives gearbox choices and feature rows but not a complete usable matrix for every engine; its S(O) Knight automatic feature rows have no current automatic engine combination.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Current official brochure engine matrix, corresponding to compilation page 31, checked against the feature footnotes on pages 39 and 41.

evidence_gaps.what: Ground clearance, suspension specification and measured ride comfort
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The wheel sizes do not prove clearance over a speed breaker or comfort on a rough road.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official specification sheet dimensions and suspension tables, plus a documented road test identifying the trim, wheels and surfaces.

evidence_gaps.what: Boot volume, rear legroom, overall length and overall width
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Folding seats and pictures of bags do not establish capacity, comfort for particular passengers or fit in a particular parking space.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official brochure dimensions and luggage-capacity tables, followed by a physical seating and luggage check.

evidence_gaps.what: Crash-test rating and body structure evidence for the exact model and year
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Airbags and assistance equipment do not establish a crash score or equal crash performance across trims.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Applicable official crash-test report and manufacturer body safety section.

evidence_gaps.what: Measured acceleration, fully loaded diesel climbing performance, fuel use, smoothness and noise
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Engine figures and manufacturer descriptions support explaining the choices but cannot prove these felt or measured outcomes.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official fuel-economy certification by engine and gearbox and instrumented tests that identify the vehicle, load and conditions.

evidence_gaps.what: Measured front-seat comfort or cooldown time after parking in sunshine
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The registry establishes airflow through the cushions, not how fast the seats or cabin cool, and it does not establish refrigerated seat air.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: A documented seat-ventilation test describing the ambient conditions, initial temperature and measurement method.

evidence_gaps.what: Reconciled entry price and current on-road prices by trim and city
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The page body states ₹10,90,700 while its structured data says ₹10.79 lakh; neither is a verified current city-specific on-road total.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Current official price listing and an itemised local Hyundai dealer quotation identifying the engine and trim.

evidence_gaps.what: Standard warranty, service schedule, local service access, maintenance costs, and extended warranty coverage and prices
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Paid petrol extended-warranty eligibility alone does not answer the ongoing cost or coverage questions.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official warranty booklet and service schedule, authorised service locator, local maintenance estimate and current extended-warranty package terms.

evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: No approved source supports a retained-value promise.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Recent documented valuations or completed sales matched by age, engine, trim, mileage and city.

evidence_gaps.what: Ambient lighting specification and trim availability
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: This category-library feature has no supporting registry entry.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official feature-availability table and a photo of the lighting fitted to an identified trim.

evidence_gaps.what: Absent literal feature pictures and ownership visuals
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: No supplied description literally shows automatic gearbox controls, rear recline operation, rear vents, rear shade, parking sensors, camera displays, brakes, hill-start operation, wireless mirroring and its adapter, Alexa controls, glove-box cooling, prices or warranty terms.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Labelled manufacturer or showroom photographs and feature demonstrations for these items, plus current official price and warranty documents.

evidence_gaps.what: Local stock, delivery date and a usable test-drive booking destination
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: A closing action must not promise an unverified delivery or send the buyer to an invented booking route.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Current local dealer confirmation and its verified test-drive booking page.

notes: Editorial centre: settling into a car for a warm evening drive that starts in town and can carry on farther; the evidence-backed decision is which engine and gear-changing choice to start with, followed by the trim features worth choosing. Give the engine stop the most explanation; airflow through the seats is one brief comfort beat, not the purchase rationale. All supplied library stops remain in their relative order. To also place the moment-serving delighter immediately after the fundamentals, front-seat airflow is a separate short stop after safety; the library delighters stop later covers the remaining small comforts without repeating it. Every stop has some approved evidence, so each is required, with missing claims left as gaps. F002 supports an optional opening about city use and longer runs as Hyundai positioning; no reputation statement is grounded here. Evidence handoff for driving: petrol offers a six-speed manual or IVT; diesel offers a six-speed manual or six-speed automatic; turbo petrol uses a seven-speed DCT and is listed only for King, which also has other engines. Do not imply all King cars are turbo or every trim has every gearbox. Use the turbo power and diesel torque only as specifications; any driving descriptions from F010–F012 remain attributed manufacturer descriptions. Drive and traction modes and paddle shifters have automatic-only rows for S(O), S(O) Knight, SX Premium, King, King Knight and Lounge Edition, but the current engine matrix supplies no S(O) Knight automatic combination and no SX automatic. Auto hold is unavailable on E, EX, EX(O) and SX; automatic-only on S(O), S(O) Knight and SX Premium; standard on King, King Knight and Lounge Edition, with the same S(O) Knight combination caveat. It holds the vehicle while stationary; do not guarantee every surface. Wheel handoff: R16 on E, EX and EX(O); R17 on S(O), SX and SX Premium; R18 on S(O) Knight, King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; no ride comparison follows. Rear split seat, rear vents, rear armrest and front armrest storage are standard; rear recline starts S(O), rear shade EX(O), and sliding front armrest operation is only King, King Knight and Lounge Edition. Show the split seat as a choice between passenger and luggage room, not a boot-capacity figure. Safety handoff: airbags, stability control, disc brakes, hill-start assistance, tyre-pressure monitoring and rear parking sensors are standard. Hill-start assistance is a manufacturer-stated aid, not a substitute for driver responsibility. Driving assistance is King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; adaptive stop-go applies only to automatics in those trims. Surround and blind-spot cameras start SX Premium, which does not extend the other driving-assistance features to SX Premium. Every assistance explanation retains F034: attentive safe driving remains necessary and intervention is not guaranteed. Ventilated front seats and Bose sound start SX Premium. Seat airflow is through the cushions, without a cabin-cooling claim. Separate front temperature settings start S(O). Both stated screens are exactly 26.03 cm (10.25 inches), starting SX. Bluelink starts SX, with three complimentary years and dependence on adequate power and network. The supported remote engine-start route is Alexa Home to Car from SX, with separate Alexa hardware; do not substitute a phone-app claim. Phone mirroring starts EX, and SX and above use the wired-to-wireless adapter with device compatibility required. Both front power seats and driver memory are King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; driver power adjustment separately starts SX Premium. The panoramic roof starts EX(O), with voice operation starting SX; do not derive a safety or reduced-distraction benefit. Driver-side welcome lamps start SX, both sides are King, King Knight and Lounge Edition, and glove-box cooling starts S(O). Images identify visible subjects only, not trim applicability; im29 does not authorise a wireless-charging claim and im30 does not authorise a seatback-table claim. At ownership, any price must carry the compilation date of 19 September 2026, the same-page conflict, its ex-showroom scope and the requirement for a fresh dealer quote; local tax, registration and insurance are extra. Up to seven years of extended warranty is petrol-only and paid separately, and the package coverage and cost remain unknown. Facts listed with an unknown objection are partial context, not a supported complete answer.
